claims.text: The withdraw function refuses an amount that is more than the balance.
claims.source: PR.md bullet 1 and the no-overdraft contract

plain.what: The withdraw function stops when the amount is more than the balance. It raises OverdraftError.
plain.proof: A unit test (V01) calls withdraw with a large amount. We deleted the guard line, and the test went red.

claims.text: The withdraw function returns the balance minus the amount.

plain.what: The withdraw function gives the balance minus the amount.
plain.proof: It is not proven. A test (V02) exists, but it checks only the type of the result. We changed the result, and the test stayed green.
plain.warning: The test cannot find a wrong result. Thus, it is weaker than it looks.

claims.text: Many threads can call the wallet module at the same time.

plain.what: Many threads can use the wallet at the same time.
plain.proof: It is not proven. Only the PR text says it.

claims.text: A denial message does not show the account number.

plain.what: A denial message does not show the account number.
plain.proof: A model reviewer (V05) read each message. This is a model opinion, not a tool check.

claims.text: No wallet module imports a network library.

plain.what: The wallet sends nothing over the network: no wallet module imports a network library.
plain.proof: A grep (V06) finds no import of a network library in the wallet modules.

verifiers.description: OverdraftTest calls withdraw with an amount above the balance and expects OverdraftError.
BalanceTest calls withdraw and expects an int.
cc-check format reads the @cc syntax in wallet/core.py.
A gpt reviewer read each denial message in a fresh context and looked for an account number.

recorded.result: No finding. The reviewer found no account number in the denial messages.

verifiers.provenance: The PR author ran the reviewer. understando recorded the result and did not run it.

verifiers.description: A grep at the head looks for an import of socket, urllib or http in the wallet modules.
verifiers.provenance: understando runs it at the PR head (scripts/mechanical.py).

controls.description: Remove the line that raises OverdraftError.

edits.find: raise OverdraftError(f"{amount} is above the balance")

controls.description: Add the amount to the balance, not take it away.
Put a colon into the contract ID, which the grammar does not permit.

glossary.meaning: an amount that is more than the balance.
a bug that we put in the code on purpose, to see if a check finds it.
the amount of money in an account.

verdict_intros.Proven: For each claim here, a tool check went red on a planted bug.
verdict_intros.Backed: For each claim here, evidence exists, but no control went red.
verdict_intros.Asserted: For each claim here, only the PR text says it.
verdict_intros.Gap: For each claim here, no check exists, and the PR does not state the claim.
